headlines.title_en: PBOC holds special lecture
headlines.summary_en: On July 10, the People's Bank of China held a special lecture, attended and chaired by PBOC Secretary and Governor Pan Gongsheng. Zhu Min, Dean of the Institute of National Financial Research at Tsinghua University and former Vice President of the IMF, gave a lecture titled 'Evolution of the International Monetary System: Theory and Practice,' covering research results and constructive thoughts on the development of the international monetary system, criteria for currency internationalization, and the progress of digital currencies, followed by exchanges with participants.

headlines.title: China’s factory gate prices rise in June amid brief Iran war respite
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices continued to rise in June despite a temporary easing of the US-Iran conflict that had previously driven up energy costs, while domestic demand remained weak.
The producer price index (PPI) increased 4.1 per cent year on year last month, compared with a 3.9 per cent rise in May, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Thursday.

headlines.title: 多机构预测上半年GDP增速超4.5% 下半年关键看出口和房地产
headlines.summary: 【多机构预测上半年GDP增速超4.5% 下半年关键看出口和房地产】从目前已披露的机构预测来看，二季度经济增速大概率较一季度有所回落。多家研究机构预计，二季度GDP同比增长4.2%至4.5%，上半年GDP增速则有望保持在4.5%至4.7%区间。多家机构认为，随着逆周期调节力度加大，财政政策进一步发力、重大项目建设提速，以及促消费、稳投资等政策持续落地，三、四季度经济增速有望较二季度小幅回升，全年GDP增速预计在4.7%左右。

headlines.title_en: Multiple institutions forecast H1 GDP growth to exceed 4.5%; H2 focus on exports and real estate
headlines.summary_en: Multiple institutions predict H1 GDP growth exceeding 4.5%; H2 performance hinges on exports and real estate. From disclosed institutional forecasts, Q2 GDP growth is likely to moderate from Q1. Many research institutions expect Q2 GDP to grow 4.2%-4.5% YoY, with H1 GDP estimated to stay in the 4.5%-4.7% range. Institutions believe that with intensified counter-cyclical adjustments, further fiscal policy efforts, accelerated major project construction, and sustained implementation of consumption-boosting and investment-stabilizing policies, Q3 and Q4 GDP growth may slightly rebound from Q2. Full-year GDP growth is projected at around 4.7%.

headlines.title: 中国酒业协会：强化酒类平台反垄断与反不正当竞争，杜绝强制二选一、限流逼价等行为
headlines.summary: 中国酒业协会发布《推动酒类平台经济创新与健康发展》一文。文中称，行业行稳致远离不开法治化、常态化监管。酒类平台诸多乱象，根源在于监管规则与酒水特殊流通属性适配不足。要遵循数字经济与酒类产业规律，革新监管理念，完善全链条监管机制。坚持法治监管，严厉打击线上售假、价格欺诈、数据滥用、算法歧视；聚焦平台流量、定价、抽成、溯源四大核心环节，强化酒类平台反垄断与反不正当竞争，杜绝强制二选一、限流逼价等行为；建立市场监管、酒业协会、平台企业跨部门协同机制，打通产区、线上、线下跨区域联动执法，完善酒水全程溯源标准，保障主播、经销商、消费者合法权益，构建多方共赢格局。

headlines.title_en: China Alcoholic Drinks Association: Strengthen anti-monopoly and anti-unfair competition in liquor platforms, ban forced exclusivity, traffic throttling, and price coercion
headlines.summary_en: The China Alcoholic Drinks Association released an article titled 'Promoting Innovation and Healthy Development of Alcohol Platform Economy,' stating that stable industry growth relies on rule-of-law and normalized regulation. Many chaos in alcohol platforms stems from inadequate adaptation of regulatory rules to the special distribution characteristics of alcoholic beverages. It calls for following the laws of digital economy and the alcohol industry, innovating regulatory concepts, and improving chain-wide oversight mechanisms. It emphasizes law-based regulation, cracking down on online counterfeiting, price fraud, data abuse, and algorithmic discrimination; focusing on the four core links of platform traffic, pricing, commission, and traceability; strengthening anti-monopoly and anti-unfair competition actions in alcohol platforms, eliminating forced exclusivity and traffic-restricting price coercion; establishing a cross-departmental coordination mechanism among market regulators, industry associations, and platform enterprises; facilitating cross-regional collaborative enforcement across production areas, online, and offline channels; improving full-chain traceability standards for alcoholic beverages; safeguarding the legitimate rights and interests of livestreamers, distributors, and consumers, and building a win-win scenario for all parties.

headlines.title: 券商业绩迎高光时刻，最高预增693.5%
headlines.summary: 7月刚过10天，已有9家上市券商发布2026年半年度业绩预告，无一例外实现高增长，招商证券等更是直言经营业绩已创历史新高。具体来看，从绝对值计，中信证券、国泰海通双双净利润超200亿元；从增幅计，天风证券以最高693.5%的增幅领跑。更为亮眼的是，多家券商在第二季度实现业绩爆发，5家单季净利增幅翻倍。非银分析师研判，随着财报陆续披露，市场对2026年证券业务的预期差有望逐步修复，券商板块估值修复空间显著。（券商中国）

headlines.title_en: Securities industry earnings shine, with some seeing up to a 693.5% surge.
headlines.summary_en: Just 10 days into July, 9 listed brokerages have released 2026 H1 earnings pre-announcements, all reporting high growth without exception. China Merchants Securities stated outright that operating results hit a record high. In absolute terms, CITIC Securities and Guotai Haitong both posted net profits exceeding RMB 20 billion. In growth terms, Tianfeng Securities led with a maximum increase of 693.5%. More notably, several brokerages saw Q2 earnings surge, with 5 posting single-quarter net profit growth of over 100%. Non-bank analysts suggest that as financial reports are gradually disclosed, market expectations for 2026 securities business are likely to be incrementally revised. The valuation recovery space for the broker sector is significant. (Securities China)

headlines.title: Expanding AI and chip firms push up rents in Beijing’s hi-tech district
headlines.summary:
Demand for Beijing’s grade-A office buildings increased in the first half of the year, with artificial intelligence and semiconductor companies making the Zhongguancun area a hot property at a time when office markets nationwide are still struggling.
Home to the capital’s densest cluster of hi-tech firms, Zhongguancun was the only submarket to post rent growth in Beijing, China’s second-largest office market after Shanghai, according to a report from property consultancy Knight Frank on...
